meta.title: Mister Pagliacci: a sad clown who tells jokes from your desktop
meta.description: Mister Pagliacci lives in your menu bar or taskbar and tells a joke about once an hour, in one beat or two. Quiet during calls. No network. Free.
meta.ogTitle: Mister Pagliacci: a sad clown for your desktop
meta.ogDescription: He tells a joke about once an hour and knows when to stop. Free for Mac and Windows.
meta.ogImageAlt: A joke set in large type on red: I asked the circus for a raise. They gave me bigger shoes.

og.subtitle: A sad clown for your desktop

store.mac: Download on the Mac App Store
store.soon: Coming soon to the Mac App Store

hero.intro: Mister Pagliacci is a sad clown who lives in your menu bar or taskbar. About once an hour, he tells you a joke.

manners.title: He tells jokes. Never on a call.

promise.body: He never goes online, and every joke, every setting and his voice are free. A one-time Supporter purchase dresses him in his other costumes.

finale.title: And who makes him laugh?
finale.prompt: Go on. I’ve heard them all.

get.title: Give him a spot on your desktop.
get.lede: He's small, he's polite, and he could use the company.

footer.fonts: Set in Bodoni Moda (SIL Open Font License).

notFound.title: Nobody here.
notFound.body: This page doesn't exist. He looked. He even checked behind the curtain.

runtime.callCut: On a call. He stopped mid-word and won't make a sound until you hang up.
runtime.callQuiet: On a call. Not a sound until you hang up.
runtime.callOver: Call's over. He'll leave it a while before the next one.
reactions: Ha! Don't tell anyone. The tear is painted on; the smile isn't.
